title: Milestone: 25 successful agentic Squid rounds
summary: Verified milestone on 2026-10-24: 25/25 consecutive agentic Squid cycles completed after one initial calibration, alignment, descent, grip and return Home. Each cycle delivered and released the plate at Squid, returned Home empty, ran imaging, waited for verified imaging completion and loading-position return, retrieved the plate and returned Home. All 332 steps completed; total duration 35 minutes 56 seconds. Physical robot and physical Squid XYZ stage; simulated camera, 125 simulated images (5 per cycle). Operator reported success. Historical result only; not optical imaging validation or authorization for future motion.
